text: I can state CAP with Gilbert and Lynch's definitions (linearizability, every non-failing node responds, arbitrary message loss) and sketch the two-replica proof.
I can explain why a distributed system cannot opt out of partitions and why a slow node looks the same as a partitioned one.
I can describe what clients on the majority and minority side of a partition see in etcd, Cassandra at ONE, and Cassandra at QUORUM.
I can explain how a deposed leader serves a stale read and how a read index or lease prevents it.
I can give three reasons the "pick 2 of 3" triangle misleads and still use CP and AP as shorthand precisely.
I can classify a system with PACELC and calculate the latency cost of consistent reads and writes across regions.
